requirements.location: Complete report plan chapters1–10, exhibit list and U-IND/U-LOG/U-ARCH/U-DATA/U-HOME/U-CONTROL/U-ECON contributions.
requirements.basis: Read the full task and entire outline including each contribution/dependency. Industrial operation, distinct logistics tasks and household handling remain task-defined with conventional automation as an appropriate comparison. The architecture/data/control contributions separately explain learned policy, hardware, fixtures, low-level control and human assistance; their synthesis addresses distribution change rather than attributing all gains to models. Deployment dates and commercial stages, intervention denominators, exception recovery and sustained operating burdens are explicitly carried into the economic and adoption sections. The plan includes contraction/exit evidence and alternative explanations. Route–data–task map, staged deployment comparison, feedback loop and all three adoption decisions are planned. No new required experiment or fixed positive conclusion is imposed.
